reviews.text_en: I went there twice during my stay. The first night, the woman served me, I went to smoke there, and as I was leaving, she told me she'd given me 100 baht in extra change. No problem, I paid her. I went back three days later, and she pulled the same trick on me. Bad luck for her, I only had a 1000 baht note. She insisted she'd given me 100 baht too much in change. I told her that was all I had, and the change was right there, lol. Just so you know, be careful and don't get ripped off. 100 baht is nothing, but just so you know...
